description.value: True North Distilleries is a craft distillery in Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, producing Canadian whiskeys (including the 54-40 and 54-40 10 reserve series), gin (Djinneh), and absinthe. They offer bookable tasting experiences for both whiskey and absinthe, and run a Barrel Buyers Club allowing enthusiasts to purchase shares in aging barrels with custom-labeled bottles at maturity. A retail store on site sells their spirits range.

address.value: 103-680 Berwick Rd. S, Qualicum Beach, BC
